title: Dimension at a point of a finite type algebra over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and $\mathfrak p\subset S$ a prime ideal, with localization $S_{\mathfrak p}$ and residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $\dim_{\mathfrak p}(\operatorname{Spec}S)$ be the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at the point $\mathfrak p$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], $\dim S_{\mathfrak p}$ the Krull dimension of the ring $S_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] and $\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ the transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then all three are finite and $$\dim_{\mathfrak p}(\operatorname{Spec}S)=\dim S_{\mathfrak p}+\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(\mathfrak p).$$
